steps.description:
1. The tire dispenser at the beginning of this chapter requires a bit of precision.
2. All you need to do is **jump over one of the two trolleys, and make a gap between them** to slow down the tire.
3. When you grab the tire, it will appear at the ramp that is found below.
4. You have to **push the tire all the way to the left, and then run towards the center platform**.
5. Next, **push the crate to the left**.
6. When the tire rolls back up for a second time, you can **get the crate through the door before its closure**.

1. Next, there is a gear that can be found to the right.
2. What you have to do is **pull the lever to start it, and then put the crate on the gear**.
3. It will then slowly move to the other side.
4. Next, **ride the gear to the top, and then pull the second crate on the platform**.
Finally, **use the two crates as stepping stones to reach the exit** - one in the corner and one on the switch.
